description: This file implements report merging functionality for Playwright test reports, including parsing, patching, and modernizing report events, as well as handling report files and merging configurations.

classes.name: UniqueFileNameGenerator
classes.description: Generates unique file names to avoid conflicts when extracting report files.

classes.name: IdsPatcher
classes.description: Patches test IDs in report events to ensure uniqueness across merged reports.

classes.name: AttachmentPathPatcher
classes.description: Adjusts attachment paths in report events to point to the correct resource directory.

classes.name: PathSeparatorPatcher
classes.description: Converts file paths in report events to match the platform's path separator.

classes.name: GlobalErrorPatcher
classes.description: Prefixes error messages and stacks with a bot name prefix for clarity.

classes.name: JsonEventPatchers
classes.description: Manages a collection of event patchers and applies them to events.

classes.name: BlobModernizer
classes.description: Converts older report event formats to the current format version.

methods.name: createMergedReport
methods.description: Main function to merge multiple report files into a single report, handling parsing, patching, and event dispatching.

methods.name: parseCommonEvents
methods.description: Parses and filters common report events from a buffer.

methods.name: parseTestEvents
methods.description: Parses and filters test-specific report events from a buffer.

methods.name: splitBufferLines
methods.description: Splits a buffer into lines based on newline characters.

methods.name: extractAndParseReports
methods.description: Extracts report files from zip archives and parses their events.

methods.name: findMetadata
methods.description: Extracts metadata from report events and checks version compatibility.

methods.name: mergeEvents
methods.description: Merges report events from multiple shards into a unified event stream.

methods.name: mergeConfigureEvents
methods.description: Combines multiple configuration events into a single configuration.

methods.name: mergeConfigs
methods.description: Merges two configuration objects into one.

methods.name: mergeEndEvents
methods.description: Creates a final onEnd event summarizing all shard results.

methods.name: sortedShardFiles
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of report shard files.
